description_en: Queries waiting room events for a waiting room
description_zh: 查询等候室的等候室事件详情
name: ListWaitingRoomEvents

parameters.help_en: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the waiting room, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 等候室ID，用于标识特定的等候室。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html接口获取
parameters.name: waiting_room_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the waiting room event. This parameter is optional. You can specify this parameter to query a specific waiting room event
parameters.help_zh: 等候室事件ID，可选参数，用于查询特定等候室事件
parameters.name: waiting_room_event_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace a call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于追踪调用情况

WaitingRoomEvents.description_en: The details of the waiting room events
WaitingRoomEvents.description_zh: 等候室事件列表，包含每个事件的具体信息

items.description_en: The details of the waiting room event

CustomPageHtml.description_en: The content of the custom waiting room page. This parameter is returned when the waiting room type is set to custom. The content is URL-encoded
CustomPageHtml.description_zh: 用户自定义等候室页面内容，当等候室类型为自定义类型时，需要传入。传入的内容需要经过URL编码

DisableSessionRenewalEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether session renewal is disabled. Valid values:

on

off
DisableSessionRenewalEnable.description_zh:
禁用会话续订。支持：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Enable.description_en:
The event status. Valid values:

on

off
Enable.description_zh:
事件启用状态。
on ：表示启用。
off：表示禁用

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the event. This value is a UNIX timestamp

JsonResponseEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether JOSN response is enabled. If JSON response is enabled, a JSON body is returned for requests to the waiting room with the header Accept: application/json. Valid values:

on

off
JsonResponseEnable.description_zh:
JSON响应。开启后accept请求头包含"application/json"会返回JSON数据。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

Language.description_en:
The language of the waiting room page. This parameter is returned when the waiting room type is set to default. Valid values:

enus: English.

zhcn: Simplified Chinese.

zhhk: Traditional Chinese
Language.description_zh:
等候室页面的语言，当等候室类型为默认类型时，需要传入。支持以下类型：

enus：英文。
zhcn：中文简体。
zhhk：中文繁体

Name.description_zh: 事件名称，自定义的事件描述

NewUsersPerMinute.description_en: The maximum number of new users per minute

PreQueueEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether pre-queuing is enabled. Valid values:

on

off
PreQueueEnable.description_zh:
预排队开关。

on：开启。
off：关闭

PreQueueStartTime.description_en: The start time for pre-queuing. This value is a UNIX timestamp. This parameter is valid only when pre-queuing is enabled
PreQueueStartTime.description_zh: 预排队开始时间（Unix时间戳），若开启预排队功能则有效

QueuingMethod.description_en:
The queuing method. Valid values:

random: Users gain access to the origin randomly, regardless of the arrival time.

fifo: Users gain access to the origin in order of arrival.

passthrough: Users pass through the waiting room and go straight to the origin.

reject-all: Users are blocked from reaching the origin
QueuingMethod.description_zh:
排队方式。取值：

random：随机。
fifo：先进先出。
passthrough：直通。
reject-all：拒绝全部

QueuingStatusCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code to return while a user is in the queue. Valid values:

200

202

429

RandomPreQueueEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether random queuing is enabled. Valid values:

on

off
RandomPreQueueEnable.description_zh:
随机排队开关。

on：开启。
off：关闭

SessionDuration.description_en: The maximum duration for which a session remains valid after a user leaves the origin. Unit: minutes
SessionDuration.description_zh: 会话持续时间（单位：分钟）

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the event. This value is a UNIX timestamp

TotalActiveUsers.description_en: The maximum number of active users

WaitingRoomEventId.description_en: The unique ID of the waiting room event
WaitingRoomEventId.description_zh: 事件ID，唯一标识一个等候室事件

WaitingRoomId.description_en: The ID of the waiting room associated with the event

WaitingRoomType.description_en:
The type of the waiting room. Valid values:

default

custom
WaitingRoomType.description_zh:
等候室类型。支持以下类型：

default：默认类型。
custom：自定义类型
